_comment: EXAMPLE config (real data from the 'newwebinfo' repo) so you can see a fully filled-in report. Copy it to git-team-report.config.json in your repo and replace the people/findings — or run `git-team-report init` to auto-generate a blank one from your own history. Git NUMBERS are never stored here; they are pulled live on every build. This file holds only judgment: grades, code findings, prose.
